When a held piece slips or drops

A slip starts with motion inside the grasp. A drop starts when hand support ends. The seek links use the recorded grip signal and the piece’s downward motion.

Grip slip. The same builder first picks up p020. The slip occurs immediately before the intended connection; the original placement is retried.. Grip command opens at 1.83 s · Downward motion in the pose trace at 1.83 s · Exact recording input. The white plate rests on the table, with the open right hand beside it. The hand has not caught it.

Direct drop. The same builder first picks up p020. The drop occurs immediately before the intended connection; the original placement is retried.. Grip command opens at 1.83 s · Downward motion in the pose trace at 1.83 s · Visible fall, frame 23 (1.92 s) · Exact recording input. The white plate rests on the table, with the open right hand beside it. The hand has not caught it.

The public inputs request different release kinds. All 115 frames have the same sampled grip, fitted joints, object poses and camera in both recordings. Both clips show the fingers opening abruptly, the plate falling to the table, and a later pickup. Neither shows a gradual slip or an airborne catch. At the first opening, the fitted wrist moves 60.9 mm in 83 ms while the public wrist target moves 0.0 mm. Source poses, pixel comparison and timestamped observations. · Complete normal-speed playback and inspected frames.

Authored task and scenario context

Attach at a different position or connector. On Halloween Ghost.

Repair attempt leaves a problem unresolved · A target already has a recorded problem, an actual repair is attempted, and the original problem persists or the repair creates another. Inspect the residual target or new defect, then propose a different feasible adjustment.

A required part is absent from inventory · A target required by the selected step is explicitly unavailable in the recorded inventory. Check the part ID and other bags, then obtain a replacement or pause.

Request repair guidance · The scenario calls for repair advice, either after a recorded difficulty or as a conditional question. Identify the affected joint, what to release or adjust, and how to check it.

Attach at the wrong site · An accepted attachment places the piece at a non-equivalent location relative to the host. Indicate the intended site and the distance or landmark separating it from the current one.

Attach a non-equivalent module · A distinct connected module is joined where a structurally different instance is required. Show the matching module and a distinguishing feature before changing the join.
